title: Control Engineering
description: Push back on an error in proportion to it, and to how long it has lasted, and to how fast it is growing: the proportional, integral and derivative controller, which holds steady most of the world's furnaces, autopilots and reactors. Too little gain and the loop is sluggish; too much and it overshoots and rings. A loop of this kind behaves like a spring and damper, and its damping ratio decides how far it overshoots. Unlocks the PID Bench.

puzzle.goal: A second order loop with damping ratio ζ below one overshoots its setpoint by a fraction M before settling. Write M.
puzzle.name: Peak overshoot
puzzle.method: The step response is 1 − e^(−ζωt)·cos(ω√(1−ζ²)t + φ)/√(1−ζ²); its first peak comes half a damped period in.
